tagline: One compact place for every asset
brief: A unified asset platform for images, videos, audio, and files. The identity should feel precise, open, dependable, and lightly playful across browser tabs, upload centers, PWAs, READMEs, and shared links.
criteria: Success: the connected Link 8 symbol is recognizable at 16px, the 888 Box name is immediately readable, and the system works in colour, one colour, and reverse.

concepts.name: Link 8
concepts.idea: A connected 8-grid turns the repeated 888 rhythm into one open system for uploading and sharing assets.
rationale: The symbol carries the 888 name without depending on live text.
The open junction gives the system a sense of access and movement.
The custom 888 Box wordmark keeps the name present in every primary lockup.

recommendation: Link 8 — approved direction with the 888 Box wordmark added to the primary horizontal and stacked lockups.
